import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean().sort_values('Sleep Duration')
x = np.arange(len(occupation_sleep.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = axes[0, 1].bar(x - width/2, occupation_sleep['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
bars2 = axes[0, 1].bar(x + width/2, occupation_sleep['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightcoral')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
for bmi in bmi_order:
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]['Sleep Duration']
    axes[0, 2].hist(subset, alpha=0.6, label=bmi, bins=15, density=True)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
im = axes[1, 0].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 0])
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        if not mask[i, j]:
            axes[1, 0].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}', 
                           ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, 
                           color='white' if abs(corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]) > 0.5 else 'black')

# 5. Stress Level vs Physical Activity by Gender
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 1].scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'], 
                       alpha=0.6, label=gender, s=50)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend()

# Add trend lines
z = np.polyfit(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
x_range = np.linspace(df['Physical Activity Level'].min(), df['Physical Activity Level'].max(), 100)
axes[1, 1].plot(x_range, p(x_range), 'k--', alpha=0.5, linewidth=2)

# 6. Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
if not sleep_disorder_data.empty:
    box_data = [sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]['Daily Steps'] 
                for disorder in sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique()]
    bp = axes[1, 2].boxplot(box_data, patch_artist=True)
    axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels(sleep_disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].unique(), rotation=45, ha='right')
    
    # Color the boxes
    colors = ['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral']
    for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
        patch.set_facecolor(color)
else:
    axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data Available', 
                    ha='center', va='center', transform=axes[1, 2].transAxes, fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
